mapper.select: SELECT v.post_id, p.title AS post_title, COUNT(*) AS view_count, 0.0 AS percent FROM post_view_log v LEFT JOIN post p ON v.post_id = p.id WHERE v.visited_at >= #{startTime} AND v.visited_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY v.post_id, p.title ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COUNT(*) AS view_count, 0.0 AS percent FROM post_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY country ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, #{format}) AS label, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM post_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
